sources.snippet: Overview CyberRealisticPony is a specialized text-to-image diffusion model maintained by cyberdelia that merges Pony Diffusion with CyberRealistic elements to generate photorealistic pony artwork. The model uses a latent diffusion architecture with an integrated Variational Autoencoder already baked in, eliminating the need to load a separate VAE file. It runs on the Stable Diffusion Webui ...
